parameters.query:
WITH person_row AS (
  INSERT INTO persons (
    external_id,
    source,
    role,
    first_name,
    status,
    created_at,
    updated_at
  )
  VALUES (
     $1::text,
    'telegram',
    'parent',
    'Родитель',
    'active',
    NOW(),
    NOW()
  )
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
  RETURNING person_id
),
existing_person AS (
  SELECT person_id
  FROM persons
  WHERE source = 'telegram'
    AND external_id = $1::text
  ORDER BY created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
p AS (
  SELECT person_id FROM person_row
  UNION ALL
  SELECT person_id FROM existing_person
  LIMIT 1
),
conversation_row AS (
  INSERT INTO conversations (
    person_id,
    channel,
    status,
    current_stage,
    started_at,
    stage_updated_at,
    last_message_at
  )
  SELECT
    (SELECT person_id FROM p),
    'telegram',
    'active',
    'new',
    NOW(),
    NOW(),
    NOW()
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM conversations
    WHERE person_id = (SELECT person_id FROM p)
      AND channel = 'telegram'
      AND status = 'active'
  )
  RETURNING conversation_id
),
existing_conversation AS (
  SELECT conversation_id, current_stage
  FROM conversations
  WHERE person_id = (SELECT person_id FROM p)
    AND channel = 'telegram'
    AND status = 'active'
  ORDER BY started_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
c AS (
  SELECT conversation_id, 'new'::text AS current_stage FROM conversation_row
  UNION ALL
  SELECT conversation_id, current_stage FROM existing_conversation
  LIMIT 1
),
active_interview AS (
  SELECT interview_id
  FROM parent_interviews
  WHERE person_id = (SELECT person_id FROM p)
    AND status IN ('started', 'in_progress')
  ORDER BY started_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  (SELECT person_id FROM p) AS person_id,
  (SELECT conversation_id FROM c) AS conversation_id,
  COALESCE((SELECT current_stage FROM c), 'new') AS current_stage,
  (SELECT interview_id FROM active_interview) AS interview_id,
  '{}'::jsonb AS summer_map_answers,
  '{}'::jsonb AS summer_map_result;

INSERT INTO messages (
  conversation_id,
  role,
  content,
  created_at
)
VALUES (
  '{{ $("DB_LoadContext").first().json.conversation_id }}'::uuid,
  'user',
  '{{ ($("SYS_NormalizeUpdate").first().json.raw_content || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  NOW()
)
RETURNING message_id;
